lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high for unsuccessful tests, but underestimated the gains of winning tests.
Specific layout redesigns (grid view pet companion, centered sign-in, two-column path choice) were helpful, though other redesigns showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Adding new onboarding screens (such as quality validation or personality selection) consistently performed worse.
Reordering onboarding flow performed worse (narrative-first) or showed no clear effect (defer sign-in).
Most copy changes showed no clear effect, except for clear re-authentication sign-in copy which was helpful.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, wait info, notifications, or status banners showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Compact Layout Pet Companion Selection
candidates.change: Rebuilds the pet selection screen with a compact grid layout, displaying pet options in an efficient side-by-side view.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 73.1% conversion rate and a median duration of 89s. A compact layout allows users to quickly compare options without excessive scrolling.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select the pet companion that will join you on your desktop.

guard.reason: Compact layout retains pet selection functionality on pick_friend.

candidates.score_note: Grid pet companion redesign directly aligns with previous winning tests (+6.9%).

candidates.title: Card Layout Account Sign In View
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a structured card layout with clear visual authentication boundaries.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 21.7% of users and generates support emails about account confusion. Card layout provides distinct focus for authentication.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Log into your account to keep your pets and customizations safe across sessions.
sign_in.hint: Use the same email you previously registered to retain existing pets.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Grid Layout Finish Onboarding Summary
candidates.change: Transforms the final onboarding welcome screen into a structured grid layout summarizing key app features.
candidates.why: The finish step sees a high drop-off rate (64.8% completion, 395s median time) and user confusion regarding desktop features.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready
home_intro.body: Explore your pet's desktop tools and customization options.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro within onboarding is permitted and retains required screen function.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step, but general redesigns on finish step historically underperformed (-1.6%).

candidates.title: Desktop Mascot Setup Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding step presenting a desktop mascot preview component before entering the home state.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails mention pets failing to display on the desktop or users not knowing how to launch them after onboarding.

new_mascot_setup.headline: Desktop Display Setup
new_mascot_setup.body: Verify your pet companion's placement on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new mascot setup step during onboarding is allowed and preserves all existing steps.

candidates.score_note: Strong funnel and support evidence, but adding new screens consistently harms conversion (-14.7%).

candidates.title: Split Layout Path Choice Overview
candidates.change: Reconfigures the path selection screen into a split layout separating starter companion paths from custom photo generation.
candidates.why: Choose path step has a long mean completion time (514s). A clear split view helps users compare adoption methods upfront.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Onboarding Path
choose_path.body: Pick a instant ready-made companion or create a custom pet from your own photos.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Retention Warning Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in hint text to explicitly remind returning users to sign into the correct email so previous pets do not disappear.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with a different or duplicate account.

sign_in.hint: Make sure to sign in with your original email to access your existing pets.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Custom Photo Format Guidelines Copy
candidates.change: Adds explicit photo clarity and format hints on the photo upload screen during custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted failures or visual glitches during custom pet generation.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos with a centered subject for best companion generation results.

candidates.title: Animated Mascot Generation Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Adds an animated mascot component to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s). Visual animation reassures users that progress is occurring.

guard.reason: Animated progress indicator on the waiting screen clearly shows pet generation in progress.

candidates.score_note: Wait info modifications show no clear strong effect historically (+1.7% across 4 tests).

candidates.title: Story Screen Visual Preview Component
candidates.change: Replaces the intro story section with an interactive image preview component introducing desktop pets.
candidates.why: The initial story screen sets context for the entire app, helping improve early funnel engagement.

guard.reason: 'story.replace.intro_story[0]': a preview cannot do the intro_story job (use ['animation', 'button', 'image', 'mascot', 'text', 'video'])

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Component
candidates.change: Replaces the default certificate component with a stamped mascot badge component upon completing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption completion sits at 73.1%. Adding a visual badge reward before waiting builds anticipation and completion momentum.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high for unsuccessful tests, but underestimated the gains of winning tests.
Specific layout redesigns (grid view companion, centered sign-in, two-column path choice, compact companion selection) were helpful, though other redesigns showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Adding new onboarding screens consistently failed, performing worse or showing no clear effect.
Reordering the onboarding flow performed worse or showed no clear effect.
Most copy changes showed no clear effect, except clear re-authentication sign-in copy which was helpful.
Adding wait info, hints, notifications, shortcut guides, or status banners showed no clear effect.
